slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review says rural primary clinics in Zimbabwe traditionally record on paper registers, with aggregate data later entered into the national DHIS2 at district level; it gives no date, so the essay's published date is used.

Data Landscapers, citing the Global Fund's August 2025 case study, says the Impilo EMR is deployed in 1,254 of about 1,900 public health facilities (66%), a count of all public facilities rather than of primary clinics alone; the essay itself dates the figure no more closely, so its published date is used.

Data Landscapers, citing a provincial evaluation, says 72% of 153 facilities in Matabeleland South had Impilo fully functional in the first quarter of 2025, with rural districts lagging; one province only.

systems.tiers: aggregate data from rural primary clinics' paper registers entered at district level
1,254 of about 1,900 public health facilities, including rural 'last mile' sites such as Sipepa Rural Hospital

note: An AI-assisted compilation by its own account; the Zimbabwe clinic row restates the Global Fund case study (n 21) and the Matabeleland South evaluation (n 18). The essay also says solar power reached 1,044 facilities (60%) and names a National eHealth Strategy 2021-2025.
